label: Parte 2
subtitle: Describir foto + 2 preguntas · 45 seg cada respuesta
objetivo: Describir la foto (qué/dónde/quién/sensación/suposición) y responder 2 preguntas con estructura O-P-E-E-C.

pasos.title: Descripción de la foto
pasos.template: In this picture, I can see [sujeto + acción en -ing] in [lugar]. They are [ropa/aspecto] and the atmosphere looks [adjetivo de ambiente]. They seem [sentimiento], and it looks like [suposición]. In my opinion, this picture [valoración].

opciones: they're working on a joint project
they've just met up after a long time
captures a typical scene of modern life
reflects how we spend our free time
shows the importance of human connection

pasos.trick: 'seem' + 'it looks like' = especulación B2 puro. Demuestra que sabes hablar sin afirmar.
pasos.warning: 'There IS two people' → ERROR. Es 'There ARE two people'. Plural obligatorio.

pasos.title: Responder pregunta asociada (O-P-E-E-C)
pasos.template: From my point of view, [opinión clara]. For example, in my case, I [ejemplo personal en presente]. This means that [consecuencia]. All in all, [cierre].

opciones: it's something we should make time for
it has a big impact on how we feel
make a point of seeing my family every week
spend time outdoors as often as I can
it really takes a load off my mind

pasos.trick: Mete un idiom en el ejemplo: 'takes a load off my mind', 'brings out the best in me', 'it's a no-brainer'.

temas.label: Office / Workplace
temas.descripcion_foto: Una oficina moderna con varias personas trabajando con ordenadores.
preguntas: Describe what you can see in this picture.
Do you prefer working in a team or alone? Why?
How has work changed in the last 20 years?
temas.respuesta_modelo: In this picture, I can see three colleagues working on their laptops in a modern office. They are dressed in smart casual clothes and the atmosphere looks bright and welcoming. They seem focused, and it looks like they're working on a joint project. In my opinion, this picture captures a typical scene of modern professional life.

temas.label: Park / Outdoors
temas.descripcion_foto: Gente paseando, corriendo y disfrutando en un parque soleado.
preguntas: Describe what you can see in this picture.
Do you enjoy spending time outdoors? Why or why not?
What are the benefits of green spaces in cities?
temas.respuesta_modelo: In this picture, I can see several people enjoying a sunny afternoon in a city park. They are dressed in casual clothes and the atmosphere looks lively and relaxed. They seem cheerful, and it looks like they're making the most of the good weather. In my opinion, this picture reflects how important green spaces are in our daily lives.

temas.label: Family meal
temas.descripcion_foto: Una familia comiendo junta alrededor de una mesa.
preguntas: Describe what you can see in this picture.
How often do you have meals with your family?
Why are family meals important?
temas.respuesta_modelo: In this picture, I can see a family of four having dinner around a wooden table. They are dressed in casual clothes and the atmosphere looks warm and homely. They seem cheerful, and it looks like they're celebrating something special. In my opinion, this picture captures the importance of spending quality time with our loved ones.

temas.label: Classroom
temas.descripcion_foto: Estudiantes en un aula prestando atención al profesor.
preguntas: Describe what you can see in this picture.
Did you enjoy your school years? Why?
Has classroom learning changed in recent years?
temas.respuesta_modelo: In this picture, I can see a group of students taking notes in a bright classroom. They are dressed in casual clothes and the atmosphere looks focused and quiet. They seem engaged, and it looks like they're listening to an interesting lecture. In my opinion, this picture reflects the importance of education in our personal growth.

temas.label: Shopping
temas.descripcion_foto: Personas comprando en una calle comercial o centro comercial.
preguntas: Describe what you can see in this picture.
Do you enjoy shopping? Why or why not?
How have shopping habits changed in recent years?
temas.respuesta_modelo: In this picture, I can see a couple of friends walking through a busy shopping street with bags in their hands. They are dressed in casual clothes and the atmosphere looks lively. They seem cheerful, and it looks like they're enjoying a weekend break. In my opinion, this picture captures how shopping has become a leisure activity for many people.

temas.label: Sport / Exercise
temas.descripcion_foto: Gente haciendo deporte en un gimnasio o al aire libre.
preguntas: Describe what you can see in this picture.
Do you do any kind of exercise? Why?
Why is sport important nowadays?
temas.respuesta_modelo: In this picture, I can see a group of people exercising together in an outdoor space. They are dressed in sportswear and the atmosphere looks energetic and motivating. They seem focused, and it looks like they're following a training session. In my opinion, this picture reflects how more and more people care about their health.

temas.label: Café / Restaurant
temas.descripcion_foto: Personas charlando en un café o restaurante acogedor.
preguntas: Describe what you can see in this picture.
Do you enjoy going out to cafés? Why?
What role do cafés play in social life?
temas.respuesta_modelo: In this picture, I can see two friends having coffee in a cosy café. They are dressed in casual clothes and the atmosphere looks warm and welcoming. They seem at ease, and it looks like they're catching up after a long time. In my opinion, this picture captures how cafés bring people together in modern cities.

temas.label: Public transport
temas.descripcion_foto: Personas viajando en metro, autobús o tren.
preguntas: Describe what you can see in this picture.
Do you use public transport often? Why?
What are the advantages and disadvantages of public transport?
temas.respuesta_modelo: In this picture, I can see several passengers travelling on a busy underground train. They are dressed in casual and work clothes and the atmosphere looks quite hectic. They seem tired, and it looks like they're on their way to work. In my opinion, this picture captures a typical scene of city life.
